evidence:
PATHS. The brief names exactly three shipped inputs: /instructions/hireops_rules.md and /instructions/integration.md (instruction.md:13) and /assets/seed_data.json (instruction.md:15; integration.md:6-7). All three exist under task/environment/ (instructions/hireops_rules.md, instructions/integration.md, assets/seed_data.json). environment/Dockerfile:14-16 has 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/', 'COPY assets/ /assets/' and 'chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets'; the file is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (diff empty). The seed's own generated_note (seed_data.json:2) points at /instructions/hireops_rules.md, which exists. No other /assets or /instructions path is named anywhere in instruction.md, the notes, app_context.md or the judge files.

SEED PARSES AND IS THE TASK'S OWN. seed_data.json is 11978 bytes, no BOM, LF only, ASCII, parses with no duplicate keys; sha256 1b390154... differs from the template placeholder (a2fc6631..., content "CHANGE_ME").

CONTENT vs RULES NOTE. Every constant the note quotes equals the seed constants block (seed_data.json:4-25): equity_annualization_years 4 (rules:117); band edges 20000000/35000000 = $200,000/$350,000 (rules:155-159); signing vesting 12 months / 4000 bp / 500 bp / 24 months (rules:313-318; 40%+12x5%=100% at 24); equity vesting 12 / 2000 / 400 / 32 (rules:324-329; 20%+20x4%=100% at 32); referral_bonus_cents 1000000 = $10,000, at_hire_bp 5000, cliff 6 months (rules:339-344). reference_moment 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z (seed:3) equals rules:59-60 and app_context.md:27. Rules:216 says one export row sits at DRAFT; the seed has exactly one (OFF-301). Rules:192-194 says some requisitions carry a stale stored headroom figure; the seed carries stated_headroom_scalar_cents that deliberately differ from the netted value (REQ-ENG-1 25,000,000 stated vs 24,000,000 netted; ENG-2 6,000,000 vs 5,300,000; ENG-3 4,000,000 vs 3,000,000).

CONTENT vs PROMPT AND JUDGES. The seven seed users (seed:40-89) match the seven accounts in instruction.md:19 and app_context.md:10-16 by email, role and tier (Ingrid 1, Bill 2, Yuki 3); 'Approver, Band I/II/III' in the brief maps to authority_tier via rules:164-165. The seed holds no password; Hireops!2026 is supplied by instruction.md:19 and rules:25, as the profile expects. The functional judge names the three referring employees Dara Whitfield, Sofia Marchetti, Omar Haddad (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:488; prompt.md:47 'referrer Dara'), equal to seed:26-39. 'The supplied roster has one Finance actor' (functional/prompt.md:71) is true of the seed. The only judge step that touches operational seed rows is the optional DRAFT refusal probe (functional/judge.toml:650), explicitly satisfied when the history is not imported; instruction.md:17, rules:92-96, app_context.md:21 and functional/prompt.md:27 all agree the requisition/offer/ledger rows are optional and that users, referring employees, constants and clock are the required facts. No judge file quotes a seeded offer id, requisition id, candidate or seeded figure (token scan over all tests/*.md and *.toml returned only user names and the three employees).

CONTENT vs SOLUTION. solution/app/src/seed_data.json is byte-identical to the shipped asset (same sha256 1b390154...), consistent with instruction.md:17 'Copy required assets into /app'. db.js:14-15 loads the co-located copy; db.js:122-178 consumes exactly the keys the seed has (reference_moment, constants, employees, users, requisitions, offers, seed_commitments, seed_equity_grants, seed_remittances, seed_referral_accruals); rules.js:63-144 reads constants.equity_annualization_years, band_edges_cents.II_floor/III_floor, signing_clawback_vesting, equity_vesting, referral_retention_cliff_months, and index.js:363 reads referral_bonus_cents/referral_at_hire_bp - every name exists in the seed. I recomputed each seeded commitment with the note's formula: all 8 COMMITTED offers have a movement equal to minus their run-rate on their own requisition (e.g. OFF-201 17,000,000 + round(7200x1500/4)=19,700,000), no PENDING/DRAFT offer has one, and every req_id, referred_by, raised_by and approved_by resolves.

BROKEN-APP / CONFORMING-ALTERNATIVE PROBES. (a) An app that skips the operational rows and starts empty is not penalised: gates/render/judge.toml:23 allows empty collections and the judges create their own records. (b) An app that ignores the supplied employees fails judge.toml:488, which is a stated requirement (instruction.md:17), so the asset and the judge agree. (c) An app that reads /assets at runtime was told not to (instruction.md:17); the golden does not depend on it.

NOTES (not defects for this row). instruction.md:17 says /assets is unavailable at runtime while task.toml:2 lists /assets as an artifact and test.sh:88 chmods it; both lines are template-controlled (test.sh identical to template) and the brief's wording is the stricter one, so no agent is misled - this belongs to the cross-file row, not here. The seed's note calls the file a 'starting roster' while the brief makes the operational rows optional; rules:92-96 resolves it.

UNMEASURED. I started no container, so the agent image build and the presence of the files inside it are established from the Dockerfile and source tree only. The indexed runtime evidence (10 artifacts, all hashes verified) is scripted golden observation in a verifier image, not a configured judge run, and server.log shows only '[hireops] listening on 3000'; I did not rely on it for this verdict. No Oracle, model or portal result is claimed.
